pattern: proxy finish LIGHT (proxy_finish.py stage_light + proxy_finish_light.py): the frozen Pixal3D sheet proxy kept as generated (geometry + texture), made watertight, decimated, baked, optionally reposed with bones

config.fit_side_length_why: proxy gate (sha cbbd25d9): side length / front height 0.794 vs the sheet's 0.729 (+8.9 %, the body too long front-to-back): Y scaled x 0.918 to the sheet (orchestrator unit note)

refloor.why: sheet_proxy floored a TAIL-feather tip (x -1.56, y 2.43, z 0.000, behind the body); the one foot hangs 0.134 u above it (lowest toe x 1.00, y -0.05, z 0.134). Floor moved to the lowest FOOT contact (y -0.8..0.7, |x| >= 0.7: the foot, never the tail). NO rescale to the front height (front-vs-side reconcile): the sheet front is a 3/4 view (6.72 u) and taller than the ortho views (back 6.54, side 6.33); the refloored height 6.56 u sits on the back view. Run 1 with x1.0244 to 6.72: GATE back 0.777 / side 0.809; run 2 without: back 0.815 / side 0.808

config.midline_x_why: sheet_proxy centred the BBOX, which the tail swung to -x skews: the body midline sits at x +0.40 after refloor (eye centres x 0.734 / 0.090 -> 0.402 (unscaled frame); beak x 0.09..0.71; chest front point x 0.40); moved to x 0 so the rig and the mirror test use the body's own plane (frame shift only, geometry untouched)

dense.why: the head: phoenix crest (top z 6.72), hooked beak (tip x 0.01, y -2.50, z 4.85) and both eyes (proxy sha cbbd25d9, stage-1 frame after the side-length fit / refloor / midline); vg_weight 0.3 so the eye and gem boxes below sit denser
the +x eye (amber iris texels 221,124,63 at x 0.324, y -1.845, z 5.38; dark ring around it): held denser so iris / pupil / lid land on separate faces
the -x eye (iris texels 231,151,91 at x -0.320, y -1.859, z 5.39): held denser like the +x eye

the chest ember gem (painted, see recolour3d gem_*; glow3d ember_gem): held dense so the small diamond keeps its own faces and the glow does not spread to a whole feather facet (vulture_creature pendant lesson)

mirror_copy.why: v1.1 (orchestrator): the proxy has ONE leg (+x; leg texels only at x 0.25..1.44) because the sheet back + side views draw one; forced 3-view and seeds 7 / 101 also gave one leg. The +x leg is copied to -x across the body midline (x 0 after midline_x 0.40): box 1 = the foot and talons (x 0.38..1.5, y -0.5..0.72, z 0..0.42: 40184 dark leg + 4557 talon samples, 394 other), box 2 = the scaly tarsus up into the thigh feathers (x 0.38..0.92, y 0.28..0.78, z 0.38..1.75; the top reaches the -x feather mass at z 1.75..1.85 so the cap is hidden); the tail feathers (y > 1.5) are outside both boxes. Rest pose = mirror-symmetric copy (the sheet side view stagger is pose)

floor_lift.why: after the refloor to the foot the trailing tail-feather tips behind the body (x -2.6..-1.5, y 2.07..2.50) hang 0.137 u below the floor (the sheet draws them past the floor line); squashed up onto z 0 within the bottom 0.45 u; the foot (y < 0.75) keeps weight 0

light.ao_why: AO baked on the watertight low itself: the layered-feather soup has inner shells that black-hole AO rays (crystal_canine / vulture_creature lesson)
light.ao_distance_why: about one feather-blade width: real crevices darken, the broad feather mass does not (batch lesson: AO darkens the basecolor below the sheet)
light.ao_fill_below_why: AO texels < 0.04 (bake origins between fused feather blades where every ray is occluded) refilled from their valid neighbours
light.bake_drop_interior_why: proxy faces with solid on both sides (inner shells under the layered feathers) left out of the bake source so the cage stays tight
light.uv_island_margin_why: the feather low unwraps into thousands of islands; margin 0.001 keeps the atlas texel coverage up (vulture_creature lesson)

recolour3d.name: legs_scaled_brown
recolour3d.why: UNIT NOTE: the leg reads near-black (proxy leg texels median 45,20,21, L* 10.1) where the sheet draws scaled brown (chip 70,52,54; sheet side-view foot 67,45,42, L* 21). Dark texels (L* <= 32) of the leg / foot (x 0.15..1.6 after the midline shift, z < 1.55) to 74,54,54 (the chip +~5 % for AO), the proxy's scale shading kept (gamma 0.8); the bright wing-feather tips that hang past the leg are not selected

recolour3d.name: feather_tips_orange
recolour3d.why: UNIT NOTE (tone): the proxy is darker than the sheet at every quantile (proxy surface L* p10/50/90 6.1 / 21.0 / 47.0 vs the sheet back+side masks 15.1 / 33.0 / 65.6; matched quantiles q85-95 proxy 196,67,39 vs sheet 244,131,79, q95-100 231,117,72 vs 252,192,113). The flame-tip texels (L* >= 38, b* >= 30) to the sheet orange chip region (236,122,72 = chip 248,127,74 x0.95), the proxy's root-to-tip gradient kept (gamma 0.85, clip to 1.5: the brightest tips land on 255,183,108 = the sheet's yellow chip 253,197,109). The HEAD (crest / beak / eyes as generated, brief) and the gem box are excluded

recolour3d.name: feathers_red
recolour3d.why: UNIT NOTE (tone): the red feathers read dark red-brown: proxy body texels (z 1.5..4.45) L* p10/50/90 5.7 / 17.9 / 38.5 (median 90,12,11) vs the sheet side body 17.8 / 34.1 / 65.3 (median 136,51,48); quantile-matched proxy 99,12,11 -> sheet 132,44,44 (q40-55), 154,32,21 -> 198,76,60 (q70-85). Red texels (a* >= 16, L* <= 40) to 138,50,40 (between the chips 127,45,46 / 157,66,60), the proxy's feather shading kept (gamma 0.7, clip 0.25..1.55: the darkest stay deep red 35..50,12..18; the brightest land near 214,78,62). Simulated on the proxy surface samples: body L* p10/50/90 -> 16.4 / 33.7 / 56.4. Head and gem excluded

recolour3d.name: neck_feathers_brown
recolour3d.why: the layered dark neck / shoulder feathers (the sheet's dark chip 70,52,54; proxy texels a* < 16 median 70,51,51 -> 76,56,58, +~8 % for AO); runs after the red lift (lifted reds keep a* > 30, so they are not reselected)

recolour3d.name: gem_rim
recolour3d.why: spec: a small glowing ember GEM on the chest; the proxy has none (chest front at z 3.6..4.2 is the dark neck-feather V, 70..88,32..46,30..50). Painted where the sheet draws it: front view px (105, 412) -> z 3.83, 11 x 22 px = a 0.11 x 0.22 u diamond at the bottom tip of the dark V, on the chest midline (front surface y -1.81). A vertical chain of spheres (r 0.045 / 0.03 / 0.015) approximates the diamond; rim colour = the sheet gem's outer pixels (median 240,118,66)

recolour3d.name: gem_core
recolour3d.why: the gem's hot yellow core (the sheet gem's brightest pixels 255,201,108)

glow3d.name: ember_gem
glow3d.why: glow ONLY on the chest gem (brief: the sheet draws it lit): the gem's faces -> palette region ember_gem (emission 248,127,74); nothing else is emissive

chains.name: wing
chains.why: the hanging razor wings: shoulder (x 0.6, z 3.9) down the outer feather mass (proxy |x| 1.1..1.6 at z 1..3) to the flame tips near the floor; 3 bones per side

chains.name: leg
chains.why: hip (inside the feathers), knee / ankle (the scaly tarsus column x 0.47..0.6, y 0.54..0.59 at z 0.65..1.45), foot to the middle talon (toe texels z 0.05..0.25, y -0.4..0.6); the -x chain follows the mirror_copy leg (exact mirror of the +x leg)

chains.name: tail
chains.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17: 'ember rex tail is moved to one side, can we rig it so we can position it in the center or the side'): a 4-bone TAIL CHAIN (tail.0..tail.3) through the trailing feather fan, the part of the proxy that is NOT mirror-symmetric (vertex mirror distance > 0.25 u: 655 verts, x -2.54..-0.17, y 0.71..2.44, z 0..1.8). The fan hangs from the -x hip (its root x -0.3, y 1.0, z 1.7) and trails back + to -x along heading 58 deg from +y; the joints lie in ONE vertical plane along that heading (horizontal 0.5 u steps, the fan's side-view droop z 1.7 -> 1.2 -> 0.75 -> 0.35 -> 0.03), so repose heading +y turns every bone by the same yaw: the fan moves as one rigid body (shape and length kept) and rests centred; the chain poses it to either side

clips.why: PLACEHOLDER (movement + height are the open artist questions): idle = breathe 1.5 deg + the kit's wing / tail sway; walk = a short raptor stalk-step (leg_swing 8: the kit's foot bend dips the toes below the floor at larger swings)

config._doc: LIGHT finish of the raw Pixal3D proxy (seed 56, back + side generation, sha cbbd25d9). Points: stage-1 frame (Y x 0.918 side-length fit, refloored to the foot, no rescale, midline x -0.40), sheet units. v2: + repose (tail centred by a rigid yaw of the tail chain; legs / head identity; head rigid).

targets.why: artist 2026-10-17: symmetric rest pose. The -x leg is the v1.1 light.mirror_copy of the +x leg (joints exact mirrors), so the pair is already mirror-symmetric: an identity stated here (joint mirror error 0), both feet planted on z 0

targets.heading: -y
targets.why: the head straight ahead: already straight (beak tip x -0.005; face (y < -1.3) mirror mean is lowest at 0 deg in a -4..+4 deg yaw sweep about the neck joint: 0.036 / 0.029 / 0.025 / 0.024 / 0.027 / 0.031 / 0.040 u), so the neck / head yaw is 0 (an identity, stated); the head is RIGID (below)

targets.heading: +y
targets.why: the tail on the midline (heading +y = every bone yawed 58 deg about the tail root's vertical axis: one rigid turn, no feather bent or squashed). Root / heading picked on the v1 pre-repose low by a sweep (root x 0 / -0.15 / -0.3 / -0.4, z 1.5 / 1.7, heading 50..66 deg): root (-0.3, 1.0, 1.7), 58 deg = the lowest vertex mirror p99 with the least stretch (offline: mirror p99 1.026 -> 0.365, edge stretch p99 1.81; a midline pivot doubled the stretched edges and centred worse, 0.41). Default falloff, no reach: a reach left the outer fan tips behind, sharper falloffs tore more

rigid.why: the head / face (crest, beak, both eyes; the v1 dense head box) moves as ONE rigid body with the head bone: never deformed or re-sculpted (face as generated)

repose.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17, 'our characters should be symmetrical head turns are done through posing so our models remain flexible'): the proxy's swung tail is undone with BONES (proxy_finish_repose), never by mirror-averaging geometry; legs (mirror copy) and head were already symmetric / straight

mirror_copy.rule: proxy faces with centroid in a box reflected x' = 2 * plane_x - x (winding reversed) into the bake source; the reflected SDF unioned inside the mirrored boxes before the remesh; originals untouched

high.rule: marching tets of the whole remesh grid (no mirror)

low.method: collapse decimation: uniform to 300000, then 18000 with the dense boxes calibrated

dense.rule: dense boxes weighted 0.02 (vs 1) in the collapse decimation; the factor bisected until the boxes hold density x the rest's triangles per area

ao_fill.rule: AO < below = a bake origin inside the proxy soup: refilled from the covered valid 3x3 neighbours ring by ring (opt-in light.ao_fill_below)

bake.source: the proxy mesh itself (not the remesh)

rows.why: glow ONLY on the chest gem (brief: the sheet draws it lit): the gem's faces -> palette region ember_gem (emission 248,127,74); nothing else is emissive

glow3d.rule: faces -> glow palette regions (emission -> Glow -> Emission Color); rgb white keeps the baked albedo

stretch_all.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

repose.rule: LBS with the contract rig's weights (+ rigid pins), yaw-only straightening (+ lift), applied as rest

stretch_leg.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

stretch_neck_head.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

stretch_tail.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

self_intersections.rule: intersecting triangle pairs sharing no vertex (BVH overlap)

mirror_before.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

mirror_after.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

floor.rule: stage 1 floored the FEET at z 0; the centring puts the lowest point at 0

facing.rule: shell centroid -> the front-most midline point of the shell (proxy finish default)

mirror.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)
